tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "contract_price_not_yet_effective", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0240", "detail": "Line 1 'Stretch Film 500mm (rol)' is ordered at a PO unit price of 81400 for quantity 17."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-029#11.1", "detail": "Addendum No. 1 dated 7 August 2026 changes the Stretch Film 500mm (rol) unit price to Rp 96.100 only with effect from 6 October 2026."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "SUK-26-00113", "detail": "Invoice dated 2026-09-26 bills line 1 at 96100 per unit, before the 2026-10-06 effective date of the contract price."}, {"kind": "goods_receipt", "ref": "GR-2026-0240", "detail": "Goods receipt of 2026-09-24 covers the full PO quantities (17/15/10); billing position shows invoiced 4043397 against value received with tax of 3766008, so invoicing is not within_received."}], "explanation": "The 96100 unit price on line 1 is the contract price set by addendum KTR-V-029#11.1, but that price only takes effect on 2026-10-06, after the 2026-09-26 invoice date, so the PO price of 81400 still applies and the line is overpriced pending the addendum's effective date."}]}
